subject: Copywriting
title: Ethical Copywriting Principles
description: A quick win: understand Ethical Copywriting Principles.

hook.text: Every copywriter has a choice: use these techniques to inform or to manipulate.

buildup.text: Ethical Copywriting Principles sets up the core claim, the assumptions, and the stakes.

discovery.text: The FTC, ASA, and other regulators require substantiation for advertising claims.

twist.text: Some argue all advertising is manipulative because it creates desire where none existed. The debate remains unresolved.

climax.text: The ethical copywriter's standard: would I be comfortable if my reader knew every technique I used?

punchline.text: Same tools, different intent. Ethical copy is propaganda you'd sign your name.

quiz.question: What is the ethical copywriter's transparency test?
options: Would I be comfortable if readers knew every technique I used?
